node.title: XR rank-five selectors reduce to one-dimensional extension lists
node.statement: For a RowC selector of affine rank five, puncture the persistent global roots P_0. The selected slopes become codewords in distinct quotient classes of a five-dimensional code C_E containing the four-dimensional kernel code K_E, all agreeing with one received word in at least 4+h+u+v positions. Their pairwise agreement is at most 4+u+v for P-A or 3+u+v for P-B. K_E has v loop coordinates and, after deleting and scaling them, is a four-dimensional polynomial subspace W subset F[X]_<4+u. At u=v=0 this is exactly a one-dimensional extension of GRS_4. This is an exact residual reduction, not a list-size payment.
